description: This Java source file defines the EntityExpr class, which implements the EntityCondition interface and represents infix condition expressions used in entity queries within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes constructors, condition validation, and methods for generating SQL, matching maps, and checking types.

classes.name: EntityExpr
classes.description: Represents an infix condition expression used in entity queries, supporting comparison and logical operations, with methods for validation, SQL generation, and type checking.

methods.name: EntityExpr
methods.description: Constructor for comparison expressions with lhs, operator, and rhs.

methods.name: EntityExpr
methods.description: Constructor for combining EntityCondition objects with an operator.

methods.name: getLhs
methods.description: Returns the left-hand side of the expression.

methods.name: getOperator
methods.description: Returns the operator used in the expression.

methods.name: getRhs
methods.description: Returns the right-hand side of the expression.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the expression is empty based on the operator.

methods.description: Generates the SQL WHERE clause string for the expression.

methods.name: checkCondition
methods.description: Validates the condition against the model entity.

methods.name: freeze
